name: igraph
description: High-performance open-source library for network analysis and graph theory available in C, Python, and R. igraph is optimised for speed and memory efficiency on large graphs, supporting clustering, community detection, layout algorithms, and a wide range of graph metrics used in network science research.
reputation: Widely used high-performance graph library; preferred over NetworkX for large-scale network analysis due to C backend.
notes: C core with R/Python bindings; significantly faster than pure-Python alternatives for large graphs. Not a quantitative benchmark.
